resources.string: Remember the Home screen choice after an update

After an update Android forgets which app is the Home screen and asks again. When this is on and the app was the Home screen, it sets itself again (needs ADB or root). If another launcher was chosen, nothing is changed.
Make this the Home screen now
Done: the app is the Home screen
Could not do it: connect ADB or turn on root in the settings
Choose Always in the Home screen window
